a 12 week indicated prevention program designed for adolescents with some depressive symptoms and a negative attributional bias was effective in preventing depression and dysthymia 12 months after the program ended.

the development of an indicated prevention program for the first episode of major depressive disorder (MDD) and/or dysthmic disorder (DYS) among adolescents.
the identification of adolescents who are at risk for the initial episode of MDE and/or DYS.
the development of a preventive intervention for the first episode of MDD and/or DYS.

a school-based prevention program for at risk adolescents can effectively prevent the onset of depression and/or the first episode of dysthymia in a 12 month time span.
